alt: Pass rate against completion tokens in log-spaced bins on a 0.70 to 1.00 axis, one line per typical threshold plus the release arm, task-count table under the axis and a cap-hit count column at the right
caption: _Pass rate against how long the completion ran, per typical threshold, on a [0.70, 1.00] axis so the differences are visible. Cap hits are off the axis (their rate is 0 by construction) with their counts in the right-hand column; a bin below the axis floor is marked with a down-triangle and its value. Bins with fewer than three tasks are hollow and left out of the line. Scored from the re-scored HumanEval rows._
label: HumanEval pass rate by completion length

alt: Pass rate against per-request decode speed in fixed log-spaced tok/s bins, one line per typical threshold plus the release arm, cap hits excluded and counted separately
caption: _Pass rate against per-request decode speed in fixed log-spaced bins. The eval ran 4 concurrent requests, so this speed is a relative measure under that concurrency, not the single-stream 16K figure. Cap hits are excluded from the bins entirely, since they generate the full 32,768 tokens at high throughput and would make a length effect look like a speed one; their counts are in the right-hand column. Scored from the re-scored HumanEval rows._
label: HumanEval pass rate by per-request decode speed

alt: Decode tok/s for the twelve interleaved 16K windows in run order plus the typical sweep's own windows past a separator, fastest seed as the point with a min-max band, one colour per arm or threshold
caption: _The twelve interleaved 16K windows (A C D E x three rounds) in run order, then the typical sweep's own windows past the dotted separator. Each point is the window's fastest seed; the band is min-max over its three seeds. The dashed line is each arm's fastest window. A drift (first vs last) = +0.17 tok/s (+0.24%)._
label: 16K ABAB decode by window

alt: Decode tok/s against HumanEval pass@1, one labelled point per typical threshold plus the release arm, filled marker strict and hollow marker completed-task pass@1, horizontal band the pooled min-max decode
caption: _Decode rate against task quality, one point per operating point. The filled marker is strict pass@1, the hollow marker the completed-task value at the same decode rate; the horizontal band is the pooled min-max over that point's windows, with n in the label. Quality is one seed at the cell's own sampler._
label: decode tok/s against HumanEval pass@1
